New product can drive data licensing revenue and platform stickiness.
Simplifies partner workflows, improving adoption and retention.
Broad coverage increases utility versus siloed datasets.
Millions of STB and ACR devices
Scale is a key competitive moat in TV measurement.
Improves advertiser ROI measurement, aiding monetization.
